The bottom row is grouped under OVERALL PERFORMANCE: Math Average generally increases from about 0.29 to around 0.40, with dips; Code Average stays comparatively steady around 0.58–0.61; Overall Average rises from around 0.44 to near 0.50, with fluctuations. A red star marks a point on the Overall Average line near x=320 and accuracy about 0.51; no meaning for the star is specified.
